description:
Images fit the conversation on a phone viewport (390x844). Markdown images carry no size; tool cards pass width/height attributes (of the downscaled copy) to reserve their space. /c/markdown shows a 1170x4000 tall.png and a 3000x200 wide.png as markdown images; /c/image read the same tall.png with read_image. window.fits(selector, W, H) returns "ok" if the first image matching selector, of a WxH source, fits the conversation: it fits the column (".messages-container") and the message area (the container's clientHeight), keeps its aspect ratio (within half a pixel), its ".commentable-image-link" hugs it (width within half a pixel), and the link's ".commentable-image-badge" is on the image; otherwise it says what is off. "Check that S of WxH fits" means: wait (up to 30s) for the first image matching S to be visible; wait (up to 15s) for its naturalWidth to be greater than 0, since before the bytes arrive a markdown image has no size; then window.fits(S, W, H) should return exactly "ok". Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/markdown. Check that ".markdown-content img[src*=\"tall.png\"]" of 1170x4000 fits, then that ".markdown-content img[src*=\"wide.png\"]" of 3000x200 fits.
2. Navigate to /c/image. Check that ".screenshot-tool .commentable-image" of 1170x4000 fits.

steps.expression: new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const t = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('naturalWidth timeout')), 15000); const check = () => { const img = document.querySelector('.markdown-content img[src*="tall.png"]'); if (img && img.naturalWidth > 0) { clearTimeout(t); resolve('ok'); } else setTimeout(check, 200); }; check(); })
